#![allow(unused, non_snake_case, non_camel_case_types, unreachable_patterns, unreachable_code, clippy::all)]

use super::types;

/// Error returned by procs.
pub type Error = Box<dyn std::error::Error + Send + Sync>;

/// The node that failed, wrapping its implementation's error.
#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct NodeError {
    pub node: &'static str,
    pub source: Error,
}

impl std::fmt::Display for NodeError {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        write!(f, "{}: {}", self.node, self.source)
    }
}

impl std::error::Error for NodeError {
    fn source(&self) -> Option<&(dyn std::error::Error + 'static)> {
        Some(&*self.source)
    }
}

fn wrap(node: &'static str, source: Error) -> Error {
    Box::new(NodeError { node, source })
}

/// A failure as a program prints it: the error underneath the nodes, and
/// (when it passed through more than one) the nodes, outermost first.
pub fn describe_error(e: &Error) -> String {
    let mut nodes = vec![];
    let mut cur: &(dyn std::error::Error + Send + Sync + 'static) = &**e;
    while let Some(n) = cur.downcast_ref::<NodeError>() {
        nodes.push(n.node);
        cur = &*n.source;
    }
    if nodes.len() > 1 { format!("{cur}\n  (in {})", nodes.join(" > ")) } else { cur.to_string() }
}

fn get<'a, T>(slot: &'a Option<T>, node: &str) -> Result<&'a T, Error> {
    slot.as_ref().ok_or_else(|| format!("{node} has not run").into())
}

/// Moves a value out of its slot, at its last read.
fn take_slot<T>(slot: &mut Option<T>, node: &str) -> Result<T, Error> {
    slot.take().ok_or_else(|| format!("{node} has not run").into())
}

/// Looks up `k`, failing if it's missing.
fn map_get<K: Ord + std::fmt::Debug, V: Clone>(m: &std::collections::BTreeMap<K, V>, k: &K) -> Result<V, Error> {
    m.get(k).cloned().ok_or_else(|| format!("key {k:?} not found").into())
}

/// Indexes `xs`, failing if `i` is out of range.
fn slice_get<E: Clone>(xs: &[E], i: &i64) -> Result<E, Error> {
    usize::try_from(*i)
        .ok()
        .and_then(|i| xs.get(i).cloned())
        .ok_or_else(|| format!("index {i} out of range [0, {})", xs.len()).into())
}

/// Unoptimized, a proc's frame holds every node's temporaries at once, so
/// grammar-deep recursion overflows the default 2 MiB; debug builds give
/// their threads more.
fn thread_builder() -> std::thread::Builder {
    let b = std::thread::Builder::new();
    #[cfg(debug_assertions)]
    let b = b.stack_size(64 << 20);
    b
}

/// Runs `f` over `xs` on scoped threads; results keep input order.
fn fan_out<E: Send, R: Send>(xs: Vec<E>, f: impl Fn(E) -> Result<R, Error> + Sync) -> Result<Vec<R>, Error> {
    std::thread::scope(|s| {
        let f = &f;
        let handles: Vec<_> = xs
            .into_iter()
            .map(|x| thread_builder().spawn_scoped(s, move || f(x)).expect("cannot spawn a thread"))
            .collect();
        handles
            .into_iter()
            .map(|h| h.join().unwrap_or_else(|p| std::panic::resume_unwind(p)))
            .collect()
    })
}


/// Lends a foreign value from its slot, failing if its node hasn't run.
fn lend<'a, T>(slot: &'a mut Option<T>, node: &str) -> Result<&'a mut T, Error> {
    slot.as_mut()
        .ok_or_else(|| format!("{node} has not run").into())
}

struct EnvMain {

/// Proc Main's foreign values, each in its slot, lent to the funcs that
/// take it: its nodes' outputs, and its parameters.
#[derive(Default)]
struct ForeignMain<'f> {
    out_new: Option<types::Counter>,
    out_main_other: Option<types::Counter>,
    out_new_buf: Option<types::Buf>,
    _f: std::marker::PhantomData<&'f mut ()>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
enum PcMain {
    MainMain,
    New,
    Bump,
    MainAgain,
    MainOther,
    Move,
    MainStep,
    MainShown,
    NewBuf,
    Write,
    Text,
}

/// Runs proc Main.
///
/// Every way a foreign value travels: lent to funcs and procs, to spawn
/// branches, read in conditions, returned by a proc into a node.
pub fn run_main(start: i64, by: i64) -> Result<types::Str, Error> {
    let mut env = EnvMain::default();
    let mut foreign = ForeignMain::default();
    env.in_main_main = Some(InMainMain { start: start, by: by });
    let mut pc = PcMain::MainMain;
    loop {
        match pc {
            PcMain::MainMain => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_main_main, "Main.Main")?;
                let this = types::MainArgs { start: input.start, by: input.by };
                env.out_main_main = Some(this.clone());
                env.in_new = Some(InNew { start: this.start });
                pc = PcMain::New;
                continue;
            }
            PcMain::New => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_new, "New")?;
                let this = crate::counter::new(input.start).map_err(|e| wrap("New", e.into()))?;
                foreign.out_new = Some(this);
                env.in_bump = Some(InBump { by: get(&env.out_main_main, "Main.Main")?.by.clone(), lent: 0 });
                pc = PcMain::Bump;
                continue;
            }
            PcMain::Bump => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_bump, "Bump")?;
                let lent_c = lend(&mut foreign.out_new, "New")?;
                let this = crate::counter::bump(lent_c, input.by).map_err(|e| wrap("Bump", e.into()))?;
                let slot_main_main = take_slot(&mut env.out_main_main, "Main.Main")?;
                env.in_main_again = Some(InBump { by: (slot_main_main.by * 2_i64), lent: 0 });
                pc = PcMain::MainAgain;
                continue;
            }
            PcMain::MainAgain => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_main_again, "Main.Again")?;
                let lent_c = lend(&mut foreign.out_new, "New")?;
                let this = crate::counter::bump(lent_c, input.by).map_err(|e| wrap("Main.Again", e.into()))?;
                env.in_main_other = Some(InFreshFresh { start: 1000_i64 });
                pc = PcMain::MainOther;
                continue;
            }
            PcMain::MainOther => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_main_other, "Main.Other")?;
                let this = run_fresh(input.start).map_err(|e| wrap("Main.Other", e.into()))?;
                foreign.out_main_other = Some(this);
                let a0_c = lend(&mut foreign.out_new, "New")?;
                let a0_by = 1_i64;
                let a1_c = lend(&mut foreign.out_main_other, "Main.Other")?;
                let a1_by = 5_i64;
                let this = std::thread::scope(|s| -> Result<_, Error> {
                    let h0 = thread_builder().spawn_scoped(s, move || run_twice(a0_c, a0_by).map_err(|e| wrap("Twice", e.into()))).expect("cannot spawn a thread");
                    let h1 = thread_builder().spawn_scoped(s, move || crate::counter::bump(a1_c, a1_by).map_err(|e| wrap("Main.Side", e.into()))).expect("cannot spawn a thread");
                    let r0 = h0.join().unwrap_or_else(|p| std::panic::resume_unwind(p))?;
                    let r1 = h1.join().unwrap_or_else(|p| std::panic::resume_unwind(p))?;
                    Ok(types::MainOtherJoined { Twice: r0 })
                })?;
                env.in_move = Some(InMove { by: this.Twice, lent: 0 });
                pc = PcMain::Move;
                continue;
            }
            PcMain::Move => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_move, "Move")?;
                let lent_from = lend(&mut foreign.out_main_other, "Main.Other")?;
                let lent_to = lend(&mut foreign.out_new, "New")?;
                let this = crate::counter::move_by(lent_from, lent_to, input.by).map_err(|e| wrap("Move", e.into()))?;
                if (crate::counter::read(lend(&mut foreign.out_new, "New")?).map_err(|e| wrap("Read", e.into()))? < 100_i64) {
                    env.in_main_step = Some(InBump { by: 10_i64, lent: 0 });
                    pc = PcMain::MainStep;
                    continue;
                }
                env.in_main_shown = Some(InShowShow { lent: 0 });
                pc = PcMain::MainShown;
                continue;
            }
            PcMain::MainStep => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_main_step, "Main.Step")?;
                let lent_c = lend(&mut foreign.out_new, "New")?;
                let this = crate::counter::bump(lent_c, input.by).map_err(|e| wrap("Main.Step", e.into()))?;
                env.in_move = Some(InMove { by: 0_i64, lent: 0 });
                pc = PcMain::Move;
                continue;
            }
            PcMain::MainShown => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_main_shown, "Main.Shown")?;
                let (lent_c,) = match input.lent {
                    0 => (lend(&mut foreign.out_main_other, "Main.Other")?,),
                    1 => (lend(&mut foreign.out_new, "New")?,),
                    _ => unreachable!(),
                };
                let this = run_show(lent_c).map_err(|e| wrap("Main.Shown", e.into()))?;
                if (this.clone() > 500_i64) {
                    env.in_main_shown = Some(InShowShow { lent: 1 });
                    pc = PcMain::MainShown;
                    continue;
                }
                env.in_new_buf = Some(InNewBuf {  });
                pc = PcMain::NewBuf;
                continue;
            }
            PcMain::NewBuf => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_new_buf, "NewBuf")?;
                let this = super::buf::new_buf().map_err(|e| wrap("NewBuf", e.into()))?;
                foreign.out_new_buf = Some(this);
                env.in_write = Some(InWrite { s: types::Str::from(format!("{}{}", types::Str::from("new="), crate::counter::itoa(crate::counter::read(lend(&mut foreign.out_new, "New")?).map_err(|e| wrap("Read", e.into()))?).map_err(|e| wrap("Itoa", e.into()))?)), lent: 0 });
                pc = PcMain::Write;
                continue;
            }
            PcMain::Write => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_write, "Write")?;
                let lent_b = lend(&mut foreign.out_new_buf, "NewBuf")?;
                let this = super::buf::write(lent_b, input.s).map_err(|e| wrap("Write", e.into()))?;
                env.in_text = Some(InText { lent: 0 });
                pc = PcMain::Text;
                continue;
            }
            PcMain::Text => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_text, "Text")?;
                let lent_b = lend(&mut foreign.out_new_buf, "NewBuf")?;
                let this = super::buf::text(lent_b).map_err(|e| wrap("Text", e.into()))?;
                return Ok(this);
            }
            _ => return Err(format!("Main: invalid state {pc:?}").into()),
        }
    }
}

/// Runs proc Show.
///
/// A counter's count.
pub fn run_show(c: &mut types::Counter) -> Result<i64, Error> {
    let mut env = EnvShow::default();
    let mut foreign = ForeignShow { param_c: Some(c), ..Default::default() };
    env.in_show_show = Some(InShowShow { lent: 0 });
    let mut pc = PcShow::ShowShow;
    loop {
        match pc {
            PcShow::ShowShow => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_show_show, "Show.Show")?;
                let this = types::ShowArgs {  };
                env.in_read = Some(InRead { lent: 0 });
                pc = PcShow::Read;
                continue;
            }
            PcShow::Read => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_read, "Read")?;
                let lent_c = &mut **lend(&mut foreign.param_c, "Show.Show")?;
                let this = crate::counter::read(lent_c).map_err(|e| wrap("Read", e.into()))?;
                return Ok(this);
            }
            _ => return Err(format!("Show: invalid state {pc:?}").into()),
        }
    }
}

/// Proc Twice's foreign values, each in its slot, lent to the funcs that
/// take it: its nodes' outputs, and its parameters.
#[derive(Default)]
struct ForeignTwice<'f> {
    param_c: Option<&'f mut types::Counter>,
    _f: std::marker::PhantomData<&'f mut ()>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
enum PcTwice {
    TwiceTwice,
    Bump,
    TwiceSecond,
    TwiceId1,
}

/// Runs proc Twice.
///
/// Bumps a counter it borrows twice.
pub fn run_twice(c: &mut types::Counter, by: i64) -> Result<i64, Error> {
    let mut env = EnvTwice::default();
    let mut foreign = ForeignTwice { param_c: Some(c), ..Default::default() };
    env.in_twice_twice = Some(InTwiceTwice { by: by, lent: 0 });
    let mut pc = PcTwice::TwiceTwice;
    loop {
        match pc {
            PcTwice::TwiceTwice => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_twice_twice, "Twice.Twice")?;
                let this = types::TwiceArgs { by: input.by };
                env.out_twice_twice = Some(this.clone());
                env.in_bump = Some(InBump { by: this.by, lent: 0 });
                pc = PcTwice::Bump;
                continue;
            }
            PcTwice::Bump => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_bump, "Bump")?;
                let lent_c = &mut **lend(&mut foreign.param_c, "Twice.Twice")?;
                let this = crate::counter::bump(lent_c, input.by).map_err(|e| wrap("Bump", e.into()))?;
                env.in_twice_second = Some(InBump { by: get(&env.out_twice_twice, "Twice.Twice")?.by.clone(), lent: 0 });
                pc = PcTwice::TwiceSecond;
                continue;
            }
            PcTwice::TwiceSecond => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_twice_second, "Twice.Second")?;
                let lent_c = &mut **lend(&mut foreign.param_c, "Twice.Twice")?;
                let this = crate::counter::bump(lent_c, input.by).map_err(|e| wrap("Twice.Second", e.into()))?;
                let slot_twice_twice = take_slot(&mut env.out_twice_twice, "Twice.Twice")?;
                env.in_twice_id1 = Some(InTwiceId1 { value: (slot_twice_twice.by * 2_i64) });
                pc = PcTwice::TwiceId1;
                continue;
            }
            PcTwice::TwiceId1 => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_twice_id1, "Twice.id1")?;
                let this = input.value;
                return Ok(this);
            }
            _ => return Err(format!("Twice: invalid state {pc:?}").into()),
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]

    out_fresh_fresh: Option<types::FreshArgs>,

/// Proc Fresh's foreign values, each in its slot, lent to the funcs that
/// take it: its nodes' outputs, and its parameters.
#[derive(Default)]
struct ForeignFresh<'f> {
    out_new: Option<types::Counter>,
    out_fresh_id1: Option<types::Counter>,
    _f: std::marker::PhantomData<&'f mut ()>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
enum PcFresh {
    FreshFresh,
    New,
    Bump,
    FreshId1,
}

/// Runs proc Fresh.
///
/// A new counter, bumped once, given back.
pub fn run_fresh(start: i64) -> Result<types::Counter, Error> {
    let mut env = EnvFresh::default();
    let mut foreign = ForeignFresh::default();
    env.in_fresh_fresh = Some(InFreshFresh { start: start });
    let mut pc = PcFresh::FreshFresh;
    loop {
        match pc {
            PcFresh::FreshFresh => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_fresh_fresh, "Fresh.Fresh")?;
                let this = types::FreshArgs { start: input.start };
                env.in_new = Some(InNew { start: this.start });
                pc = PcFresh::New;
                continue;
            }
            PcFresh::New => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_new, "New")?;
                let this = crate::counter::new(input.start).map_err(|e| wrap("New", e.into()))?;
                foreign.out_new = Some(this);
                env.in_bump = Some(InBump { by: 1_i64, lent: 0 });
                pc = PcFresh::Bump;
                continue;
            }
            PcFresh::Bump => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_bump, "Bump")?;
                let lent_c = lend(&mut foreign.out_new, "New")?;
                let this = crate::counter::bump(lent_c, input.by).map_err(|e| wrap("Bump", e.into()))?;
                env.in_fresh_id1 = Some(InFreshId1 { lent: 0 });
                pc = PcFresh::FreshId1;
                continue;
            }
            PcFresh::FreshId1 => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_fresh_id1, "Fresh.id1")?;
                let this = take_slot(&mut foreign.out_new, "New")?;
                return Ok(this);
            }
            _ => return Err(format!("Fresh: invalid state {pc:?}").into()),
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]
struct EnvUnused {
    in_unused_unused: Option<InUnusedUnused>,
    out_unused_unused: Option<types::UnusedArgs>,
    in_unused_make_later: Option<InUnusedMakeLater>,
    in_unused_use_later: Option<InUnusedUseLater>,
    out_unused_use_later: Option<i64>,
}

/// Proc Unused's foreign values, each in its slot, lent to the funcs that
/// take it: its nodes' outputs, and its parameters.
#[derive(Default)]
struct ForeignUnused<'f> {
    out_unused_make_later: Option<types::Later>,
    _f: std::marker::PhantomData<&'f mut ()>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
enum PcUnused {
    UnusedUnused,
    UnusedMakeLater,
    UnusedUseLater,
}

/// Runs proc Unused.
///
/// Builds around a placeholder.
pub fn run_unused(n: i64) -> Result<i64, Error> {
    let mut env = EnvUnused::default();
    let mut foreign = ForeignUnused::default();
    env.in_unused_unused = Some(InUnusedUnused { n: n });
    let mut pc = PcUnused::UnusedUnused;
    loop {
        match pc {
            PcUnused::UnusedUnused => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_unused_unused, "Unused.Unused")?;
                let this = types::UnusedArgs { n: input.n };
                env.in_unused_make_later = Some(InUnusedMakeLater { n: this.n });
                pc = PcUnused::UnusedMakeLater;
                continue;
            }
            PcUnused::UnusedMakeLater => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_unused_make_later, "Unused.MakeLater")?;
                let this = unimplemented_unused_make_later(input.n).map_err(|e| wrap("Unused.MakeLater", e.into()))?;
                foreign.out_unused_make_later = Some(this);
                env.in_unused_use_later = Some(InUnusedUseLater { lent: 0 });
                pc = PcUnused::UnusedUseLater;
                continue;
            }
            PcUnused::UnusedUseLater => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_unused_use_later, "Unused.UseLater")?;
                let lent_l = lend(&mut foreign.out_unused_make_later, "Unused.MakeLater")?;
                let this = unimplemented_unused_use_later(lent_l).map_err(|e| wrap("Unused.UseLater", e.into()))?;
                return Ok(this);
            }
            _ => return Err(format!("Unused: invalid state {pc:?}").into()),
        }
    }
}

pub type Str = Arc<str>;

/// An array. Immutable, so a clone shares it. `concat` reuses this one's
/// buffer when nothing else shares it, and copies otherwise. Derefs to a
/// slice.
#[derive(PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord, Hash)]
pub struct List<T>(Arc<Vec<T>>);

impl<T> Clone for List<T> {
    fn clone(&self) -> Self {
        List(self.0.clone())
    }
}

impl<T> Default for List<T> {
    fn default() -> Self {
        List(Arc::new(Vec::new()))
    }
}

impl<T> std::ops::Deref for List<T> {
    type Target = [T];
    fn deref(&self) -> &[T] {
        &self.0
    }
}

impl<T> From<Vec<T>> for List<T> {
    fn from(v: Vec<T>) -> Self {
        List(Arc::new(v))
    }
}

impl<T: Clone> From<&[T]> for List<T> {
    fn from(v: &[T]) -> Self {
        List(Arc::new(v.to_vec()))
    }
}

impl<T> FromIterator<T> for List<T> {
    fn from_iter<I: IntoIterator<Item = T>>(iter: I) -> Self {
        List(Arc::new(iter.into_iter().collect()))
    }
}

    type Item = T;
    type IntoIter = std::vec::IntoIter<T>;
    fn into_iter(self) -> Self::IntoIter {
        Arc::unwrap_or_clone(self.0).into_iter()
    }
}

    type Item = &'a T;
    type IntoIter = std::slice::Iter<'a, T>;
    fn into_iter(self) -> Self::IntoIter {
        self.0.iter()
    }
}

    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        f.debug_list().entries(self.iter()).finish()
    }
}

impl<T: Clone> List<T> {
    /// This array's elements, then `other`'s. Appends in place when nothing
    /// else shares this array.
    pub fn concat(mut self, other: &List<T>) -> List<T> {
        Arc::make_mut(&mut self.0).extend_from_slice(other);
        self
    }
}

/// A map. Immutable, so a clone shares it. `merge` and `without` change
/// this one in place when nothing else shares it, and copy otherwise.
/// Derefs to a `BTreeMap`.
#[derive(PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord, Hash)]
pub struct Map<K, V>(Arc<BTreeMap<K, V>>);

impl<K, V> Clone for Map<K, V> {
    fn clone(&self) -> Self {
        Map(self.0.clone())
    }
}

impl<K, V> Default for Map<K, V> {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Map(Arc::new(BTreeMap::new()))
    }
}

impl<K, V> std::ops::Deref for Map<K, V> {
    type Target = BTreeMap<K, V>;
    fn deref(&self) -> &BTreeMap<K, V> {
        &self.0
    }
}

impl<K, V> From<BTreeMap<K, V>> for Map<K, V> {
    fn from(m: BTreeMap<K, V>) -> Self {
        Map(Arc::new(m))
    }
}

impl<K: Ord, V> FromIterator<(K, V)> for Map<K, V> {
    fn from_iter<I: IntoIterator<Item = (K, V)>>(iter: I) -> Self {
        Map(Arc::new(iter.into_iter().collect()))
    }
}

impl<K: Clone, V: Clone> IntoIterator for Map<K, V> {
    type Item = (K, V);
    type IntoIter = std::collections::btree_map::IntoIter<K, V>;
    fn into_iter(self) -> Self::IntoIter {
        Arc::unwrap_or_clone(self.0).into_iter()
    }
}

impl<K: std::fmt::Debug, V: std::fmt::Debug> std::fmt::Debug for Map<K, V> {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        self.0.fmt(f)
    }
}

impl<K: Ord + Clone, V: Clone> Map<K, V> {
    /// This map's entries and `other`'s; `other` wins.
    pub fn merge(mut self, other: &Map<K, V>) -> Map<K, V> {
        Arc::make_mut(&mut self.0).extend(other.iter().map(|(k, v)| (k.clone(), v.clone())));
        self
    }

    /// This map without `keys`.
    pub fn without(mut self, keys: &[K]) -> Map<K, V> {
        if keys.iter().any(|k| self.0.contains_key(k)) {
            let m = Arc::make_mut(&mut self.0);
            for k in keys {
                m.remove(k);
            }
        }
        self
    }
}
